user.title: Add a Docker host
user.description: Enter a name for this host and the address of its docker-socket-proxy (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:2375 for the local host, or http://10.10.10.10:2375 for a remote one). Add this integration again for each additional host.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the docker-socket-proxy at that address. Check the URL and that the proxy container is running.

init.title: Global settings
init.description: These settings apply to ALL configured Docker hosts, not just this one - saving here updates every host and reloads all of them. Docker Hub / GHCR credentials are optional but strongly recommended: anonymous registry requests have a low rate limit and can start failing (429 Too Many Requests) under regular use.
